reviews.reason: The status region contains the structured Ant Spin/skeleton block layout, not phrasing content or the result of a form calculation. Keep a named polite live region on the existing block element for both the server document and the interactive component.

The indicator React element is created once per component factory call, outside the returned component. The browser owner instantiates its factory at module scope; the build owner constructs it once for its static document render. Renders of LoadingState pass the same element reference regardless of layout props; this is the public ReactNode slot, not a render-local JSX allocation.
